quota_efficiency_policy.batching: Aggregate evidence for each review; don't launch multiple agents for a question one validated report can answer.
quota_efficiency_policy.content_limits: Up to three material findings / opportunities per regular specialist report, not a prohibition on reporting critical risks.
quota_efficiency_policy.daily_policy: No daily automated agent checks; run incident investigation only on material trigger.
quota_efficiency_policy.monthly_policy: Fold deeper monthly assessment into the first Monday Growth review; no separate all-agent meeting/extra native calls.
quota_efficiency_policy.rerun_policy: No automatic retries when quota, tool or source is blocked. Record BLOCKED/DEFERRED and carry the task to next available window.
quota_efficiency_policy.quota_claims: Late-night execution does not increase or reset OpenAI limits. Quota availability and exact billing metering remain unknown and must not be guessed.
quota_efficiency_policy.missing_web_agent_connector: Website Agent v1.1 reported as draft with Wix/GitHub connectors removed. Public web read-only only; no direct Wix/GitHub expectations.
quota_efficiency_policy.enforcement: These are operating guidelines, not product-level quota enforcement or a native scheduler.
